title: Pain Attunement
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Pain Attunement}}

'''Pain Attunement''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that grants [[more]] [[spell damage]] when the character is on [[low life]].

==Location==
Pain Attunement is a standalone keystone located on the inner layer of the transition area between [[Witch]] and [[Shadow]].

== Interactions ==
The [[low life]] condition can be met in various ways, such as {{il|Petrified Blood}}, [[reservation|reserving]] life via {{il|Arrogance Support}}, or {{il|Coward's Legacy}}. 

Pain Attunement does not [[snapshot]]. Its condition is checked when damage is calculated: on [[hit]], or when a [[damage over time]] effect is created (in the case of DoT affected by spell damage, like {{il|Vortex}}). This means a spell that lowers the player into low life through a [[cost]] or sacrifice (e.g. {{il|Lifetap Support}}, {{il|Sacrifice Support}}) can immediately benefit from Pain Attunement.
